name: Naive CSG Voxel Operations
definition: A brute-force GPU kernel for performing Constructive Solid Geometry (CSG) operations (Union, Intersection, Difference) on two voxel grids by processing every voxel independently.
summary: Naive CSG Voxel Operations is a brute-force GPU kernel performing Boolean voxel grid operations by processing every voxel independently, prioritizing simplicity over efficiency.
